Is there any way you can make an exception? If not, honestly, I might just send both tablets back and get everything refunded to a gift card instead. This is kind of a hassle!

Yes, that’s right—I want to return both tablets and get the refunds on my gift card. Go ahead and start the process, please!
Awesome, thanks for helping me get this sorted out! I’ll keep an eye out for that email. Have a great day! ###STOP###
